name: Seed
summary: One EPYC node, 4x used RTX 3090. Prove the human/AI research loop end to end.
goals: 96 GB VRAM online: quantized 70B-class models plus parallel 8-32B searchers
Local inference server (vLLM / llama.cpp) with an orchestration queue
First three RH avenues running nightly experiments
exitCriteria: One avenue produces a result worth writing up (positive or negative)
Cluster runs a 72-hour unattended experiment without intervention
Cost per useful experiment measured, informing Phase 1 sizing

name: Scale
summary: Grow to 2-3 nodes and 12x 3090 with cheap used 25GbE+ interconnect. ~4 kW worst case.
goals: 288 GB VRAM across 3 nodes; tensor-parallel large models plus wide search fleets
Used ConnectX-4/5 NICs and a 25GbE+ switch from eBay
Avenue portfolio expanded to 6+ with automated result triage
exitCriteria: Multi-node inference stable under week-long runs
Power draw confirmed under 4.5 kW at the wall
A ranked list of avenues by evidence gathered, to focus Phase 2

name: Heavy
summary: Decision gate: used A100/6000-Ada class vs more 3090s vs next-gen. Industrial site if power demands it.
goals: Pick hardware class from Phase 1 evidence, not speculation
If over the 5 kW envelope, execute the industrial-location move
Dedicated long-context model for proof-drafting and verification
exitCriteria: Sustained multi-week experiment campaigns on the strongest avenues
Published writeups of the machine and at least one research result
